newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea to send $6 million food aid to N.Korea.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea to send $6 million food aid to N.Korea.

text.p: South Korea will send $6 million in food aid to famine-striken North Korea, Seoul officials said on Thursday.

"We have made a formal decision to take part in the World Food Programme's aid package to North Korea," said a foreign ministry official, who asked not to be identifed. "Our contribution to the package will be $6 million."
The $6 million will be in addition to $3 million contribution Seoul made to a similar WFP aid programme last year.
Hours earlier, the United States said it would be sending an extra 10 million dollars food aid to the Stalinist state. Washington contributed $6.4 million to the U.N. body in 1996.
The Seoul foreign ministry official said details of South Korea's contribution would be announced later on Thursday.
The World Food Programme recently appealed for $41.5 million to meet North Korea's food needs. North Korea has been suffering from acute food shortages after devastating floods in the past two years.
